Why Formester for Shopify

Benefits That Make Formester the Best Shopify Form Builder

Build, customize, and manage Shopify forms with ease. Collect responses, accept payments, and connect with your tools in one simple form builder.

No Coding Needed

Create custom Shopify forms with your logo, colors, and fonts. Build order, contact, or registration forms that match your store’s branding.

Ready-Made Templates

Choose from pre-built form templates for orders, registrations, surveys, and more, customize and launch in minutes!

Easily Embed

Copy and paste the embed code into any page. Works with all Shopify themes, start collecting customer responses instantly!

Accept secure payments

Formester integrates with PayPal & Stripe, letting you collect payments for orders, pre-orders, and donations with ease.

Easily Integrate With 3rd-Party Apps

Connect with Google Sheets, Mailchimp & Salesforce to organize orders, manage leads, and send automated customer updates.

Spam-free & GDPR-compliant

Protect customer data and prevent fake submissions with built-in spam filters & Turnstile, ensuring secure and valid responses.

How it works

How to Install and Embed Shopify Forms with Formester

1

Install Formester from the Shopify App Store

  • Log in to your Shopify Admin Dashboard.
  • Click Apps in the left sidebar and go to the Shopify App Store.
  • Search for Formester - Form Builder and select it.
  • Then "Install App" to complete the setup.
2

Create and Manage Your Shopify Forms

  • Open Formester from your Shopify apps.
  • View all your existing Shopify forms in the dashboard.
  • Create a new form in just a few clicks.

Click the three dots on any form to:

  • Edit the form
  • View submissions
  • Adjust form settings
  • Manage notifications and Email autoresponders
  • Access integrations

Note: Advanced editing and settings may open in the main Formester platform.

3

Embed Your Form

  • Click Add to Store to access embedding options.
  • Form ID Embed: Copy the form ID, open Shopify’s Theme Editor → Apps → Formester, and paste the ID. Customize display mode, width, and auto height.
  • Manual Embed: Copy the HTML code, add a Custom Liquid section in Shopify, and paste it. Adjust colors, width, padding, and CSS as needed.
  • Hosted Link: Use a dedicated Formester page with a custom domain. Redirect users to this page for standalone landing pages, external campaigns, or forms outside Shopify. Fully customizable and mobile-ready.
4

Manage and Analyze Responses

  • Your form is now live and ready to collect submissions.

Use Formester’s analytics tools to track:

  • Completion rates,
  • Drop-offs,
  • User interactions,
  • Optimize your forms based on these insights to increase engagement and conversions.

Advanced

Advanced Features for Shopify Forms

AI Multi Lingual Translations

Formester makes reaching a global audience easier. With the AI multi-language translation feature, you can create forms in multiple languages and cater to diverse customers. Perfect for international businesses, e-commerce, or customer support teams.

Auto Unique ID

Automatically generate unique IDs for each form submission, improving your order management and helping you track responses with ease.

Spam Protection

Formester offers numerous spam protection options such as Turnstile, invisible reCAPTCHA, and AI-powered spam detection to make sure only the legitimate submissions are collected.
